issues.description: The Book struct declares the title property as private (private let title: String) while Client.swift accesses book.title. This visibility mismatch prevents Client from compiling against the intended Book API and contradicts the problem statement expectation that books expose title and author fields.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the title property accessible (remove the private modifier) so it matches the intended design and can be read by Client. For example: change 'private let title: String' to 'let title: String' (or 'public let title: String' if external access is required). Ensure the visibility of author and genres similarly matches the usage described in the problem statement.
